notes.title: Small Living World 2 - Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]Time for the [b][u]second[/u][/b][u] dev diary[/u]. Just in time, I should add.[/p][p]
After reworking the in-game UI, it was time to tackle the [b]main menu[/b]. I won’t show images of the previous version, as it was just a messy collection of placeholders.[/p][p]
We took the time to do it properly, hoping we won’t need to revisit it. And, I think we have achieved a pretty good result. Guillaume has drawn a superb background that sets the tone for the new visual standard. This menu raises the bar for the project’s quality.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704805/c53079cd780cf8804874376166659beaf83b57a7.png"][/img]
This should be the [i]almost final[/i] menu for the game release. It’s always a nice feeling when we start closing features.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704805/8ae4951e34088715cc7422532a5d37f791c71757.png"][/img]
[/p][p]There’s one thing missing : [b]music[/b]. Should it be an original sound track ? This is still to be defined.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Small Living World 2 - Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Welcome to the First [i]Small Living World 2[/i] Dev Diary![/b][/h3][p]Let’s call it [i]SLW2DD[/i]… or maybe just [i]Dev Diary[/i] to keep things simple.[/p][p]In this series, I’ll be sharing game development progress on a [u]monthly basis[/u]. At least, that’s the plan. Let’s see how diligent I turn out to be.[/p][p][/p][p][b]If you’ve seen the latest screenshots, you might be wondering—where’s the UI?
[/b]Well… it was hidden. Because honestly, it was super ugly.[/p][p]Over the past month, we’ve spent a lot of time [b]redesigning[/b] the [b]entire interface[/b] from the ground up. It even led to some changes in gameplay mechanics.[/p][p]Today, we have a clean and much more [b]PC-oriented menu[/b]. It’s packed with more information, and I honestly think it looks pretty good. We think you’ll like it.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704805/e0b387d30bbe97fe3edb0ba37608160623b2b3d7.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to [b]Guillaume[/b] for helping define this [u]new visual style[/u].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704805/1f31599fa6d2f09f58fbf0e30727d4c54ecd3364.png"][/img][i]Btw, those menu icons are mostly [/i][i][u]placeholder[/u][/i][i]. They will be upgraded soon.[/i] 
[/p][p]See, short and concise update, just the way we all like it. [/p][p]
[/p]
